# e2b Provider

Terraform provider for managing E2B sandboxes, volumes, templates, lifecycle webhooks, and governance evidence data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    e2b = {
      source = "536tech/e2b"
    }
  }
}

provider "e2b" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) E2B API key. May also be set with the `E2B_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) E2B Platform API base URL. May also be set with `E2B_API_URL`. Defaults to `https://api.e2b.app`.
